llm.summary: This is a markdown-only writing skill for creating structured research reports, with no hidden code, persistence, or privileged actions.

dimensions.detail: The skill expects web research for recent market data, which is proportionate to its research-report purpose but should be guided by user scope and citation needs.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only artifact/SKILL.md and no executable scripts, dependencies, hooks, or install-time behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to clarifying report requirements, gathering credible information, analyzing sources, drafting markdown reports, and reviewing quality; no prompt hijacking or unrelated authority is present.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No instructions request persistent memory writes, background workers, privilege escalation, credential access, local profile access, or durable system changes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's instructions, metadata, and examples all align with producing industry research reports, market analysis, and professional research documents.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: This skill is appropriate for research-report drafting. Users should still review cited sources and assumptions carefully, especially before using outputs for investment, business, or strategic decisions.
